decision_rule.text: STROKE FORMATION, STAGE 1 (t3 gate): RECORD ONLY. The driver screens B_f (C1d's t3 from scratch, 3000 its, clock held, both stroke/posture knobs at eps), S_f (the per-foot stroke income at w_S) and P_f (the side body-centring bonus at w_P) at seeds 3 AND 2 -- pair_on [always] queues every arm's seed-2 run whatever its seed-3 class -- and records each run's t3 suite__omni eval. Its ADOPT/REJECT lines are mechanical (blocks F, T, LEN at 95 %, the 23 guards at 99 %, R_i = max(R_eval from D00s X08-c6 vs X08-c4, R_seed from D00bs B_f s3 vs s2)) and DECIDE NOTHING: the t3 gate is the orchestrator's, from the pooled two-seed readout (replay_stroke_posture.py readout on the six suite evals), pre-registered in CHARTER.md -- P passes on pooled side body_offset <= -0.05 m vs B_f; S passes on a landed dose plus a stroke key moved beyond its band; health = moving ratio >= 0.30 on fwd/side/back plus the t3 floor, unison flag vs B_f. No block RIG, so no flag and no park: the queue runs its six screens unless a run dies (infra/NaN twice) or a candidate s3 trips the t3 floor or the dead_walker abort (a clear REJECT, not paired: that arm fails the gate's health criterion).
